tokens.name: bn-brand-primary
tokens.usage: Primary brand blue. Primary button fill, links, icon colour on light grounds, focus and selected borders. White text on it is 5.2:1. As text it reads 5.2:1 on white and 4.57:1 on bn-bg-blue, but only 4.35:1 on bn-bg-grey (below 4.5:1 for small text). Figma variable `bn/brand/primary` (Global Colors).

tokens.name: bn-brand-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of primary buttons and controls. Figma variable `bn/brand/primary/hover` (Global Colors).

tokens.name: bn-brand-white
tokens.usage: White surfaces, and text and icons on bn-brand-primary or bn-brand-dark. Figma variable `bn/brand/white` (Global Colors).

tokens.name: bn-brand-accent
tokens.usage: Marketing yellow for calls to action and highlights. Use dark text on it (bn-fonts-headings), never white. Figma variable `bn/brand/accent` (Global Colors).

tokens.name: bn-brand-bright
tokens.usage: Bright marketing blue for accents on dark grounds. Not for body text on white (3.0:1). Figma variable `bn/brand/bright` (Global Colors).

tokens.name: bn-fonts-headings
tokens.usage: Headings and strong text on white, bn-bg-grey and bn-bg-blue. Figma variable `bn/fonts/headings` (Global Colors).

tokens.name: bn-fonts-links
tokens.usage: Link and label text on white and pale backgrounds. Figma variable `bn/fonts/links` (Global Colors).

tokens.name: bn-fonts-body
tokens.usage: Body copy on white (7.45:1), bn-bg-grey and bn-bg-blue. Figma variable `bn/fonts/body` (Global Colors).

tokens.name: bn-bg-blue
tokens.usage: Pale blue background for selected, subscribed and highlighted surfaces, and round icon buttons. Figma variable `bn/bg/blue` (Global Colors).

tokens.name: bn-bg-grey
tokens.usage: Pale grey background for neutral surfaces, bookmark and share buttons, hover of destructive buttons. Figma variable `bn/bg/grey` (Global Colors).

tokens.name: bn-brand-dark
tokens.usage: Dark navy for headers, footers and dark panels. White text on it. Figma variable `bn/brand/dark` (Global Colors).

tokens.name: bn-system-yellow
tokens.usage: System warning and "on hold" status marks. Not for text on white (2.17:1). Figma variable `bn/system/yellow` (Global Colors).

tokens.name: bn-system-green-deco
tokens.usage: Success and positive status marks (icons, borders). Not for text on white (2.49:1). Figma variable `bn/system/green/deco` (Global Colors).

tokens.name: bn-system-green-bg
tokens.usage: Background behind success messages. Figma variable `bn/system/green/bg` (Global Colors).

tokens.name: bn-system-red-deco
tokens.usage: Error and destructive marks (icons, borders); 3.62:1 on white, so not for small text. Figma variable `bn/system/red/deco` (Global Colors).

tokens.name: bn-system-red-text
tokens.usage: Error and destructive text on white (5.4:1) or bn-system-red-bg (4.59:1). Figma variable `bn/system/red/text` (Global Colors).

tokens.name: bn-system-red-bg
tokens.usage: Background behind errors and the destructive button. Figma variable `bn/system/red/bg` (Global Colors).
